readerCopy.body: One sentence sets the entire response in motion. A warning, accusation, instruction, or public post triggers a filing, walkout, purchase, confrontation, or emergency call before anyone can soften the language. Mercury gives the action a message and target, while Mars gives the message force and immediate consequence. Under the conjunction, saying it and doing something about it become one event. The speed may cut through delay, but every careless word now travels with an action that cannot be easily reversed.
